source_item: Removed public names and signatures from Starlette 1.0 and earlier breaking releases
stimulus_summary: Inspect caller-selected public modules for removed lifecycle callbacks and decorators, Router lifecycle methods, legacy Jinja2Templates and FileResponse signatures, TestClient and WSGIMiddleware signatures/class attributes, removed response and GraphQL import paths, ExceptionMiddleware proxy, routing helper, and former WebSocket status aliases; also inspect current replacement APIs and adjacent status values.

stimulus_summary: Raise endpoint and stream exceptions through TestClient, retain their public tracebacks after the portal returns, release them and collect garbage from the caller thread; observe native callback deallocation and user object finalizers.

source_item: Request public callback and continuation lifetime cycles
stimulus_summary: Retain and release input-defined scope and receive cycles through unstarted and suspended Request body, JSON, stream, and form APIs; collect garbage without editing the cycle. Include worker collection and public state/header cycles.
observation_selectors: user weak references; user finalizer completion/thread; receive finally; warning category/message; every unraisable error

source_item: Public data-structure value cycles and UploadFile arithmetic reentry

observation_selectors: user weak references; public identity; finalizer thread; file-close events; size callback observations; every warning/unraisable
